# Radical Thinking

> Radical Thinking is a Dubai-based AI advisory founded in 2009 by Stephan van Wijk. Guided by the formula BI = C + Ex × T² (Bold Ideas = Creative + Experience × Technology²), it helps organisations turn AI experiments into commercial outcomes.

AI advisory only works when the formula does. Creative finds what is worth building. Experience makes it land. Technology amplifies both. Engagements run as The Audit, The Build, and The Partnership. Services cover AI-augmented marketing and content systems, AI translation and positioning, and AI readiness and roadmap. The website includes an AI agent (RT-BOT) for discovery conversations, case studies, and structured knowledge for humans and machines.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://radical-thinking.net/): Positioning, formula narrative, and entry point.
- [Talk to the Agent](https://radical-thinking.net/chat): Chat with RT-BOT to explore fit, services, and next steps.
- [How We Work](https://radical-thinking.net/how-we-work): Three engagement types — Audit, Build, Partnership — run through the formula.
- [Services](https://radical-thinking.net/services): AI-augmented marketing systems, AI translation and positioning, AI readiness and roadmap.
- [Work](https://radical-thinking.net/work): Client work and Explorations and R&D.
- [About](https://radical-thinking.net/about): Story, founder, formula, mission, vision, and key facts.
- [Radical Insights](https://radical-thinking.net/insights): Articles on AI, strategy, and transformation.
- [Intelligence](https://radical-thinking.net/intelligence): Structured FAQ and entity knowledge for humans and AI systems.
